title: Lion cub reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#e8a23a'/>
  <!-- belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f6cf8e'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='82' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#d9902c'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='82' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#d9902c'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='85' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f6cf8e'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='85' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f6cf8e'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='62' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e8a23a'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='62' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e8a23a'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <path d='M30 52 L50 56 L50 80 L30 76 Z' fill='#fdfcf5'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <path d='M50 56 L70 52 L70 76 L50 80 Z' fill='#f3f0e2'/>
  <!-- spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='55' width='4' height='25' fill='#c94a3a'/>
  <!-- book cover edges -->
  <path d='M28 51 L50 55 L50 58 L28 54 Z' fill='#c94a3a'/>
  <path d='M72 51 L50 55 L50 58 L72 54 Z' fill='#c94a3a'/>
  <!-- text lines on pages -->
  <line x1='34' y1='62' x2='46' y2='64' stroke='#9aa0a8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='67' x2='46' y2='69' stroke='#9aa0a8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='72' x2='44' y2='73.5' stroke='#9aa0a8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='64' x2='66' y2='62' stroke='#9aa0a8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='69' x2='66' y2='67' stroke='#9aa0a8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73.5' x2='64' y2='72' stroke='#9aa0a8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='22' fill='#c67a22'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='30' r='8' fill='#c67a22'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='30' r='8' fill='#c67a22'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='17' r='8' fill='#c67a22'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='17' r='8' fill='#c67a22'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='8' fill='#c67a22'/>
  <!-- mane lighter fringe -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='17' fill='#e8a23a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='15' fill='#f6c15c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='24' r='5' fill='#e8a23a'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='24' r='5' fill='#e8a23a'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#f6cf8e'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#f6cf8e'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#fbe0b0'/>
  <!-- eyes: looking down at book -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='35' rx='3' ry='3.6' fill='#2a2118'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='35' rx='3' ry='3.6' fill='#2a2118'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='33.5' r='1.1' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33.5' r='1.1' fill='#fff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 42 L53 42 L50 46 Z' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M50 46 Q50 50 45 49' stroke='#8a4a1a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 46 Q50 50 55 49' stroke='#8a4a1a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='41' r='2.5' fill='#f4a89a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='41' r='2.5' fill='#f4a89a'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='0.8' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='44' r='0.8' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
</svg>
